access_condition: general literacy plus relevant technical background
Fischer_example: needle manufacture already described in technological writings; Swedenstierna quotation on published descriptions
analytical_use: compare textual availability with practical actionability
claim_ceiling: do not infer that print was useless

what_it_makes_possible: turn written or observed information into actionable judgement
Fischer_example: Swedenstierna quotation says existing knowledge plus practical ironworking competence can guide the practitioner
analytical_use: test whether competence is prerequisite for useful transfer
claim_ceiling: do not reduce all non-textual knowledge to tacit knowledge

what_it_makes_possible: see scale, sequence, spatial organisation, live process
Fischer_example: Fischer says British industrial scale/perfection cannot be grasped without Autopsie
claim_ceiling: direct seeing is not automatically reliable

what_it_makes_possible: convert request into admission and technical conversation
Fischer_example: London K. sends Fischer toward Low Moor; strong recommendation read before two-hour works tour
analytical_use: code access infrastructure and broker function
claim_ceiling: recommendation does not guarantee equal access everywhere

what_it_makes_possible: visitor can choose otherwise restricted objects/processes to inspect
Fischer_example: Sheffield T. offers to show whatever Fischer wishes and says this is not offered to everyone
analytical_use: measure unequal visibility inside industrial sites
claim_ceiling: do not assume total transparency even for privileged visitors

what_it_makes_possible: secret process can circulate without becoming public
Fischer_example: Fischer recalls being told the still-secret caoutchouc waterproofing method c.18 years earlier
analytical_use: distinguish secrecy from immobility of knowledge
claim_ceiling: do not generalise one disclosure to whole industry

access_condition: willingness to disclose one's own information
Fischer_example: Fischer answers wages and steel-production questions in detail to become entitled to ask counter-questions
analytical_use: model technical travel as negotiated exchange
claim_ceiling: do not infer exact quid pro quo where Fischer does not state it

Fischer_example: Sheffield melter makes a crucible before Fischer; casting behaviour observed live
analytical_use: track performance/demonstration as carrier distinct from prose
claim_ceiling: demonstration does not prove later replication

what_it_makes_possible: comparison continues away from production site
Fischer_example: Low Moor staged ore-coal-coke-iron series; crucible/clay fragments; Fischer's own steel samples
analytical_use: track portable matter as evidence carrier

what_it_makes_possible: spatial/process representation can circulate across sites
Fischer_example: Alfredton furnace drawing; Beck drawings of Fischer works
claim_ceiling: drawing is selective representation, not transparent record

what_it_makes_possible: preserve access credentials and institutional judgement
Fischer_example: Fischer copies recommendation letters; Brande letter carried back into Sheffield
analytical_use: track documentary portability and private record-making
claim_ceiling: copy may not preserve every material feature of original

access_condition: legal registration, fee, disclosure sufficient for claim
what_it_makes_possible: secure priority and establish formal technical claim
Fischer_example: Fischer files two caveats in London in 1845
claim_ceiling: caveat is not equivalent to full technical publication

what_it_makes_possible: retain competitive advantage by withholding detail
Fischer_example: Swedenstierna quotation; Fischer 1846 remark that secrecy can be preferable to patenting
analytical_use: separate strategic withholding from inability to articulate
claim_ceiling: do not assume all Sheffield steel practice was secret

access_condition: photographic operator, prepared medium, suitable weather/light
what_it_makes_possible: multiply an industrial image beyond the unique drawing
Fischer_example: Croucher reproduces Beck foundry image as negative and positives
analytical_use: compare reproducibility of visual record with uniqueness of site visit

Fischer_example: Royal Mint trials Fischer steel and requests further supply
analytical_use: track authority created by external testing
claim_ceiling: trial result does not make all future batches identical
